'''Korman Reyes''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], Korman was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he tried to stop a group of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] looters that stole ancient weapons of untold destruction and artifacts. He tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] spacer to disable the Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and recover the artifacts.
